purpose: 90天海外高爾夫出國日期決策系統；第一優先為降低連續5天行程、3場球的降雨風險。

sources.refresh_policy: Check provider update metadata on every scheduled ingest; store issue and retrieval timestamps separately.
limitations: Weekly precipitation_anomaly_gt0/gt10/gt20 are probabilities of precipitation anomaly exceeding the stated climatological thresholds, not probabilities that rain occurs on a golf day.
Weekly precipitation_mean is a weekly mean/aggregate product as defined by the API; preserve provider units and do not relabel it as a point-day rainfall forecast.
Do not assume raw ensemble-member precipitation arrays are exposed by this API unless the response schema explicitly contains them.

sources.refresh_policy: Check provider update metadata; store issue and retrieval timestamps.
limitations: Monthly precipitation anomaly is a departure from the model climatology, not a daily rain probability.
Do not disaggregate monthly values into daily values or claim daily precision.
Use model-specific products and metadata; do not silently mix SEAS5 and seamless multi-model output.

sources.refresh_policy: Monthly dataset release; ingest only after dataset availability and matching hindcast data are confirmed.
limitations: Requires a Copernicus account, API token, and manual acceptance of the terms for each dataset.
Forecasts must be paired with hindcasts from the same originating system and matching initialization configuration for calibrated probabilities.
Forecast lead availability differs by originating centre; do not assume all models provide identical dates or lead times.
C3S tercile probabilities describe below/near/above-normal categories, not probability of rain on a particular day.

sources.refresh_policy: Weekly, subject to the official dataset schedule.
limitations: Taiwan regional outlook only; must not be applied to overseas golf courses.
Monthly precipitation category probabilities are not daily rain probabilities.
Geographic resolution and regional mapping must be retained from the official product.

sources.refresh_policy: Follow official JMA publication schedule; record publication time.
limitations: Regional forecast zones are not golf-course point forecasts.
Only ingest machine-readable or manually verified official products; do not scrape undocumented endpoints.
Tercile probabilities are climate-category probabilities, not daily rain probabilities.

models: ERA5-family reanalysis as exposed by provider
sources.refresh_policy: Historical archive is not a live forecast; retain retrieval date and provider model metadata.
limitations: Reanalysis is an estimate of past weather, not a direct rain-gauge observation at the golf course.
Use a consistent climatology period and disclose missing data and grid elevation differences.
Historical averages support seasonal baselines, not deterministic future weather.
